title: Heart failure: end-stage, assist device and acute
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's heart failure and any heart assist device.
note:
Chief Complaint: Shortness of breath.

HPI: Pt is an 85 y.o. female presenting for f/u of new onset shortness of breath and peripheral edema. Pt reports symptoms began approximately 2 weeks ago, worsening with exertion. Denies chest pain, palpitations, or syncope. Pt notes increased weight gain over the last few days. No cough or fever reported. Pt is a first-time presentation for heart failure. Diagnosis of acute diastolic heart failure was established during initial evaluation. Pt is currently on a diuretic regimen and presents today for assessment of symptoms and fluid status.

Medication List:
- Furosemide 40mg PO BID
- Lisinopril 10mg PO daily

Review of Systems:
Constitutional: No fever, chills, or fatigue.
CV: Positive for dyspnea on exertion and pedal edema. Denies chest pain.
Resp: Positive for mild shortness of breath. Denies productive cough.
GI: Denies nausea, vomiting, or abdominal pain.
MSK: No joint pain or swelling.
Neuro: No dizziness or focal weakness.

Social History: Retired. Lives with her daughter. Non-smoker. Denies alcohol use.

Family History: Mother had history of heart disease. Father had history of stroke.

Vitals:
BP: 128/78
HR: 72 (RRR)
Temp: 98.6 F
SpO2: 95% on RA
Weight: 162 lbs

Recent Labs:
eGFR: 65
Na: 136
K: 4.2
Cr: 1.1
BNP: 450

Exam:
Gen: Alert, oriented x3. Appears in no acute distress.
CV: RRR, regular S1, S2. No murmurs, rubs, or gallops.
Resp: CTAB. Mild crackles at bases.
Ext: 2+ pitting edema to mid-calf bilaterally.

Assessment:
1. Acute diastolic heart failure. This is the patient's first episode of heart failure.

Plan:
1. Continue Furosemide 40mg PO BID.
2. Instructed pt on daily weight monitoring.
3. Pt to call office if weight increases >2 lbs in 24 hours or >5 lbs in a week.
4. Follow up in 1 week for repeat assessment of fluid status.

Electronically signed,
D. Kowalski, DO
05/14/2026
explanations: A first, acute episode of diastolic heart failure: I50.31 (HCC 225).

distractors.why: There is no chronic heart failure: this is the first episode.

hccs.label: Acute Heart Failure (Excludes Acute on Chronic)
